title: 30 贺山谷31 你是谁32 石虎拜师
content_zh:
贺长老神识释放开来，方圆百里的范围都搜索了一个遍，只是可惜他只是扫到了几头凝元期的灵兽，然而洛豪就像凭空失踪了一般，无论他多么仔细的排查也没有检查出来，贺长老的脸色顿时大变，他没想到这个结真中期的蝼蚁居然还能逃掉他的追杀。
贺长老知道自己已经失去了抓住洛豪的机会，他在贺山谷前就不应该犹豫的。虽然心里面有点不甘心，但为了避免招惹到贺山谷里的实力强大的灵兽，贺长老只是探查了半柱香时间不到，就退出了贺山谷，返回了贺州坊市。
贺州坊市，贺少爷一脸阴沉的看着自己的护卫，嘴里是不可置信，“你说已经失去了那小子的踪迹？这怎么可能，区区一个结真中期的蝼蚁，连我义父成丹期的实力也追杀不到？“
“贺长老已经回来了，此时正在府邸中调查那个结真中期修士的来历。“凝元初期的护卫向贺少爷解释了原因。
贺少爷迫不及待的往贺长老的府邸冲去，他要知道那个结真中期的蝼蚁为何连他义父都追杀不到，这绝对是不可能的。
……
贺州坊市外，石虎和颜妍等候在一个摊前，两人正有些疑惑洛豪为何这么久还没出来时，却忽然看到五杀盗的身影，两人随即脸色大变，急忙低下了头，同时希望五杀盗不要看见他们。但是很可惜，五杀盗早就已经看见了他们，如果不是因为忌惮洛豪，他们早就抓住了石虎和颜妍了。不过他们很快也得到了了洛豪被贺长老追杀进贺山谷的消息，所以他们立刻就按捺不住朝石虎和颜妍走来。
在他们看来，连贺长老那样强大的成丹修士进入贺山谷都不一定能活下来，何况洛豪只是一个结真中期的修士，那个洛豪很明显在他们眼中是一个死人了。既然洛豪已经对他们造不成威胁了，那石虎和颜妍他们更加不想放过了，上次要不是因为洛豪，他们早就拿下了石虎和颜妍。
石虎和颜妍似乎也知道了五杀盗已经看到了他们，所以索性抬起头来正视着五杀盗，只见五杀盗围着他们两人，连他们身边的摊贩也吓得丢下了摊子逃走了。五杀盗为首凝元初期的男子一脸阴沉的看着石虎和颜妍，“交出你们身上的储物戒指，否则杀无赦。“
颜妍的俏脸立刻寒了下来，“五杀盗，别以为你们人多本姑奶奶就怕了你们，要打就打，少废话。“颜妍说完，手一带，她的五色彩绫便拿在了手中。
“小妍，待会儿我拦住五杀盗，你先逃走，只要找到洛大哥，你就会没事，五杀盗根本就不是洛大哥的对手。“石虎暗中向颜妍传音。
颜妍立即摇了摇头，“虎哥，我不走，要走一起走，要死一起死，我颜妍不是贪生怕死的人。“
“行了，你们一个都走不掉。兄弟们，给我上，拿下这两人。“五杀盗之首凝元初期的男子一挥手，长枪狠狠的刺向了石虎和颜妍。
其余四人看见老大出手了，也都纷纷出手，攻向了石虎和颜妍。
石虎和颜妍也全力出手，长剑和彩绫的配合下，砰砰，灵器相交的撞击声，地上卷起了漫天的烟尘，众人的战斗将四周的摊子都给搅乱了，越来越多的摊贩修士都远离了他们的战斗场地。石虎和颜妍的实力确实也不错，在五杀盗的全力攻击下，也能斗个旗鼓相当，何况五杀盗的实力境界都比石虎和颜妍强，石虎和颜妍能够挡下五杀盗的攻击，还是他们配合的天衣无缝，他们配合起来，就是一般的凝元中期修士也别想拿下他们。
……
贺山谷，洛豪小心翼翼的将神识从混沌书中探出去，当他并没有感应到周围的任何气息时，顿时松了一口气，神识沟通混沌书，从混沌书中出来了。洛豪出来之后，握了握紧手，心里暗暗发誓一定要努力提升实力，如果不是他有神识遁，以及他提前探知到贺长老的存在，他恐怕早就被贺长老抓住了。
甚至如果不是逃进了贺山谷，他迟早也要被贺长老给抓住，洛豪之前还觉得自己能够从成丹期手中逃脱，原来那只不过是他一厢情愿罢了，他的神识遁全力施展开来，也许凝元后期的修士不能追的上他，但是成丹期修士只要一直追着他，迟早会追上他。
贺山谷，洛豪自然知道，这是从鸿宇仙祖那里的地图玉简中知道的，贺山谷有许多强大的灵兽，就算是成丹期的修士走进贺山谷都不一定能够活着走出去。
洛豪隐匿了身形，迅速的找到了一个山洞，刚好那个山洞没有任何灵兽，洛豪决定在那个山洞继续提升实力，争取能够提升到凝元期，等他到了凝元期，那么成丹期的贺长老就绝对不可能追的上他，除非贺长老有比他的神识遁还更为厉害的遁术。

一进入山洞，洛豪就迫不及待的盘坐在地上，同时吞下了一枚聚真丹，然而在他吞下了聚真丹之后，聚真丹化作的灵气充斥进入他的经脉中，根本就捍卫不动他的经脉，更不要说提升他的实力等级一个小阶段了，洛豪的脸色一变，他没有想到一枚可以让别的结真期修士提升一个小等级的上品聚真丹竟然无法提升他的实力，而只是他的经脉多了一些灵气而已。
不过仔细一想，洛豪也就释然了，毕竟在他结真初期巅峰的时候，他就已经快要突破了，按道理一枚聚真丹甚至可以帮助他突破到结真中期巅峰，可是实际却是他只是突破到结真中期而已，看来混沌万物决虽然厉害，但这需要的修炼资源真的很可怕，洛豪相信，就算是正阳剑宗这样的三星宗门都不一定能够培养起他。
好在他还有十枚聚真丹，就算不够，他还有不少聚真丹材料，还能够炼制几炉聚真丹是完完全全没问题的。洛豪再次吞下二枚聚真丹，可是二枚聚真丹下去，洛豪也只是感到经脉被撼动了一下，洛豪再次吞下三枚聚真丹，聚真丹化为了不少的灵气充斥着他的经脉，但洛豪也只是感觉自己的经脉被拓宽了，实力境界并没有提升，不过洛豪觉得自己的实力比之前还要更为强悍了一些，现在让他再面对五杀盗，洛豪甚至不需要动用黑蛛刀，就可以秒杀五杀盗中那个凝元初期的男修。
洛豪心一横，将剩余的五枚聚真丹全部吞了下去，五枚聚真丹化为了更为强大的灵气，洛豪就感觉自己好像进入了火炉一般，全身温度开始逐渐的升高，噗，洛豪张口就喷出一口血箭，洛豪感觉自己的经脉要碎掉一般，心里顿时大骇，混沌万物决强行运转起来，吸收掉聚真丹化为的灵气。
一炷香之后，洛豪总算消化掉了聚真丹化作的灵气，而此时洛豪已经满身大汗，但洛豪的实力境界也提升到了结真中期巅峰，洛豪的经脉也被拓宽了不少，神识也更强大了一些。
洛豪正打算再炼制一炉聚真丹，准备突破到结真后期时，忽然一声恐怖的叫声震动了整个山洞，就好像发生了地震一般，山洞开始摇晃起来。洛豪的脸色大变，这恐怖的叫声表明是一头实力十分强大的灵兽，甚至比之前追杀他的贺长老的实力还强大，洛豪不知道怎么惊动了如此强大的灵兽，洛豪急忙隐匿了身形，逃出了山洞，然后隐藏在山洞附近的草丛里。
当洛豪藏起来还不到十个呼吸时间，一头七尺长的狼兽就来到了山洞边，而刚刚发出的那阵恐怖叫声的就是这头狼兽。洛豪神识探测到这狼兽顿时大吃一惊，“暗风灵狼。“
而且这头暗风灵狼的实力竟然在成丹后期，洛豪的眼光一阵阵收缩，更加收敛了自己的气息，一动也不动，他现在根本就不可是这头暗风灵狼的对手，一旦让暗风灵狼发现他，暗风灵狼一爪子就可以将他拍死。
之所以知道这是暗风灵狼还是因为洛豪从鸿宇仙祖的地图玉简上得知的，地图玉简上不仅标明了地址信息，而且还标明了贺山谷里面实力最强大的灵兽，就是暗风灵狼，暗风灵狼十分可怕，就算是同境界的人类修士也不一定能打过暗风灵狼，而且暗风灵狼的速度非常的快，也十分的聪明，一旦暗风灵狼打不过对手，就会找机会逃跑。
这头成丹后期的暗风灵狼，洛豪肯定就算是之前追杀他的贺长老遇见也会被秒杀。那强大的气势就可以撕裂一个普通的结真期修士。
好在洛豪的混沌万物决已经化为了万物，气息收敛了，即便暗风灵狼再强大，也没有感知到洛豪的气息，暗风灵狼之所以来到这里，还是因为洛豪之前吞服聚真丹闹出了不小的动静，刚好这头暗风灵狼就在附近不远，当它感知到洛豪这边有不少的灵气波动时，立刻就冲向了洛豪这边的山洞。
如果洛豪反应再慢一步，那可就会被这头暗风灵狼给逮住。这头暗风灵狼在山洞周围探查了一番，并没有察觉到任何异常，嗷呜一声，便瞬间远去。
等到暗风灵狼离开，洛豪感觉暗风灵狼已经无法探测到山洞这边时，才小心翼翼的神识探出去，发现四周没有异常的时候，洛豪才从草丛中出来。
洛豪已经决定离开贺山谷了，这里实在是太危险了，即便是横断山脉的四大禁地都不及这里危险，洛豪易容了一番，然后才小心翼翼的冲向了贺山谷出口，好在一路有惊无险，一个时辰之后，洛豪总算冲出了贺山谷。
content_en:
Elder He released his spiritual consciousness and searched an area of ​​a hundred miles. Unfortunately, he only found a few spirit beasts in the Ning Yuan stage. However, Luo Hao seemed to have disappeared out of thin air. No matter how carefully he checked, he could not find it. Elder He's expression suddenly changed. He did not expect that this ant in the middle stage of Jing Yuan could actually escape his pursuit.
Elder He knew that he had lost the chance to capture Luo Hao, and he should not have hesitated before He Valley. Although he was a little unwilling in his heart, in order to avoid provoking the powerful spiritual beasts in He Valley, Elder He only inspected half a stick of incense before exiting He Valley and returned to Hezhou Fang City.
In Hezhoufang City, Master He looked at his guard with a gloomy face, and said in disbelief, "You said that you have lost track of that kid? How is this possible? A mere ant in the middle stage of Jie Zhen can't even hunt down my adoptive father with the strength of the Dan stage?"
"Elder He has returned and is currently investigating the origins of the monk in the middle stage of Jie Zhen in the mansion." The guard in the early stage of Ning Yuan explained the reason to Young Master He.
Young Master He couldn't wait to rush to Elder He's mansion. He wanted to know why the ant in the middle stage of Jie Zhen couldn't even hunt down his adoptive father. This was absolutely impossible.
…
Outside Hezhoufang City, Shi Hu and Yan Yan were waiting in front of a stall. When the two of them were wondering why Luo Hao hadn't come out for so long, they suddenly saw the figure of the Five Kills Thief. Their expressions immediately changed and they hurriedly lowered their heads, hoping that the Five Kills Thief wouldn't see them. But it is a pity that the Five Kills Thieves have already seen them. If they were not afraid of Luo Hao, they would have caught Shi Hu and Yan Yan long ago. However, they soon got the news that Luo Hao was being chased into the He Valley by Elder He, so they immediately couldn't help but walked towards Shi Hu and Yan Yan.
In their view, even a powerful Chengdan monk like Elder He might not be able to survive if he enters He Valley. Moreover, Luo Hao is only a monk in the middle stage of Jie Zhen. That Luo Hao is obviously a dead person in their eyes. Now that Luo Hao no longer poses a threat to them, Shi Hu and Yan Yan are even more unwilling to let go. If it weren't for Luo Hao last time, they would have captured Shi Hu and Yan Yan long ago.
Shi Hu and Yan Yan seemed to know that the Wusha Thief had seen them, so they simply raised their heads and looked at the Wusha Thief. They saw the Wusha Thief surrounding the two of them, and even the vendors around them were so frightened that they dropped their stalls and ran away. The man in the early stage of Condensation, who was the leader of the Five Killing Thieves, looked at Shi Hu and Yan Yan with a gloomy face, "Hand over the storage rings you are carrying, or else I will kill you without mercy."
Yan Yan's pretty face immediately turned cold, "Five Kill Thieves, don't think that because there are so many of you, my aunt is afraid of you. If you want to fight, just fight and stop talking nonsense." After Yan Yan finished speaking, she took the five-color silk ribbon in her hand.
"Xiaoyan, I will stop the Five Kills Thief later. You run away first. As long as you find Brother Luo, you will be fine. The Five Kills Thief is no match for Brother Luo." Shi Hu secretly transmitted a message to Yan Yan.
Yan Yan immediately shook her head, "Brother Hu, I won't leave. If we want to go, let's go together. If we want to die, we will die together. I, Yan Yan, am not a person who is greedy for life and afraid of death."
"Okay, none of you can leave. Brothers, come here and capture these two people." The man in the early stage of Ningyuan, the leader of the Five Killing Thieves, waved his hand and stabbed Shi Hu and Yan Yan fiercely with his spear.
When the other four people saw the boss taking action, they all took action one after another and attacked Shi Hu and Yan Yan.
Shi Hu and Yan Yan also took action with all their strength. With the cooperation of the long sword and Cai Ling, bang bang, the collision of spiritual weapons, the ground was filled with smoke and dust. The fighting of everyone disrupted the surrounding stalls, and more and more vendors and monks moved away from their fighting site. The strength of Shi Hu and Yan Yan is indeed good. Under the full attack of the five-kill thief, they can fight equally. What's more, the strength of the five-kill thief is higher than that of Shi Hu and Yan Yan.Strong, Shi Hu and Yan Yan were able to block the attack of the Five Kill Thieves because of their flawless cooperation. When they cooperated, even ordinary middle-level Yuan Condensation monks couldn't even think of taking them down.
…
He Gugu, Luo Hao carefully probed his consciousness out of the Chaos Book. When he didn't sense any breath around him, he breathed a sigh of relief. His consciousness communicated with the Chaos Book and came out of the Chaos Book. After Luo Hao came out, he shook his hands and secretly vowed to work hard to improve his strength. If he hadn't had the ability to escape with divine consciousness and detect the existence of Elder He in advance, he would have been caught by Elder He long ago.
Even if he hadn't escaped into the He Valley, he would have been caught by Elder He sooner or later. Luo Hao thought that he could escape from the Chengdan stage before, but it turned out that was just wishful thinking. With his Divine Consciousness Escape at full strength, monks in the late Condensation Yuan stage might not be able to catch up with him, but as long as the Chengdan stage monks kept chasing him, they would catch up with him sooner or later.
Luo Hao naturally knew about He Valley, from the map and jade slips given by Immortal Ancestor Hongyu. There were many powerful spiritual beasts in He Valley. Even if a monk at the stage of becoming an elixir walked into He Valley, he might not be able to walk out alive.
Luo Hao hid his figure and quickly found a cave. There happened to be no spiritual beasts in that cave. Luo Hao decided to continue to improve his strength in that cave and strive to be promoted to the Condensing Yuan stage. When he reached the Condensing Yuan stage, it would be absolutely impossible for Elder He at the Cheng Dan stage to catch up with him, unless Elder He had an escape technique that was more powerful than his Divine Consciousness Escape.
As soon as he entered the cave, Luo Hao couldn't wait to sit cross-legged on the ground and swallowed a Zhenzhen Pill at the same time. However, after he swallowed the Zhenzhen Pill, the spiritual energy transformed from the Zhenzhen Pill filled his meridians and could not defend his meridians at all, let alone mention it. His strength level had been upgraded by a small level. Luo Hao's expression changed. He did not expect that a high-grade Zhenzhen Pill that could allow other Jie Zhen Stage monks to improve by a small level could not improve his strength, but only gave his meridians more aura.
But when he thought about it carefully, Luo Hao felt relieved. After all, when he was at the peak of the early stage of Jizhen, he was already about to break through. It stands to reason that a gathering pill can even help him break through to the peak of the middle stage of Jizhen, but in fact he only broke through to the middle stage of Jizhen. It seems that although the Chaos All Things Art is powerful, the training resources it requires are really terrible. Luo Hao believes that even a three-star sect like Zhengyang Sword Sect may not be able to train him.
Fortunately, he still has ten Zhen Gathering Pills. Even if it is not enough, he still has a lot of Zhen Gathering Pill materials. It is absolutely no problem to be able to refine several furnaces of Zhen Gathering Pills. Luo Hao swallowed two Zhen Gathering Pills again, but after the two Zhen Gathering Pills went down, Luo Hao just felt that his meridians were shaken. Luo Hao swallowed three Zhen Gathering Pills again. The Gathering Truth Pills turned into a lot of spiritual energy and filled his meridians, but Luo Hao just felt his meridians. Being broadened, the level of strength has not improved, but Luo Hao feels that his strength is stronger than before. Now let him face the Pentakill Thief again, Luo Hao can kill the male cultivator in the early stage of Yuan Condensation among the Pentakill Thief without even using the black spider knife.
Luo Hao's heart skipped a beat, and he swallowed all the remaining five Zhen-Gathering Pills. The five Zhen-Gathering Pills turned into more powerful spiritual energy. Luo Hao felt as if he had entered a furnace, and the temperature of his body began to gradually rise. Poof, Luo Hao opened his mouth and spat out a blood arrow. Luo Hao felt that his meridians were about to shatter, and he was horrified. The Chaos All Things were forcibly moving, absorbing the spiritual energy turned into by the True-Gathering Pills.
After a stick of incense, Luo Hao finally digested the spiritual energy transformed by the Juzhen Pill. At this time, Luo Hao was already sweating profusely, but Luo Hao's strength level had also been upgraded to the peak of the middle stage of Jizhen. Luo Hao's meridians had also been broadened a lot, and his spiritual consciousness had become stronger..
Luo Hao was planning to refine another batch of True Gathering Pills and prepare to break through to the late stage of Jie Zhen, when suddenly a terrifying cry shook the entire cave, as if an earthquake had occurred, and the cave began to shake. Luo Hao's face changed drastically. This terrifying cry showed that it was a very powerful spiritual beast, even more powerful than Elder He who was chasing him before. Luo Hao didn't know how he alerted such a powerful spiritual beast. Luo Hao hurriedly hid his figure, escaped from the cave, and then hid in the grass near the cave.
When Luo Hao hid for less than ten breaths, a seven-foot-long wolf beast came to the cave, and it was this wolf beast that made the terrifying scream just now. Luo Hao was shocked when his consciousness detected the wolf beast, "Dark Wind Spirit Wolf."
Moreover, the strength of this dark wind spirit wolf was actually in the late stage of becoming a pill. Luo Hao's eyes shrank, and he even more restrained his aura. He remained motionless. He was no match for this dark wind spirit wolf now. Once the dark wind spirit wolf discovered him, the dark wind spirit wolf could kill him with one claw.
The reason why he knew this was the Dark Wind Spirit Wolf was because Luo Hao learned from the map jade slip of Hongyu Immortal Ancestor. The map jade slip not only marked the address information, but also marked the most powerful spiritual beast in the He Valley, which is the Dark Wind Spirit Wolf. The Dark Wind Spirit Wolf is very scary. Even human monks in the same realm may not be able to defeat the Dark Wind Spirit Wolf. Moreover, the Dark Wind Spirit Wolf is very fast and very smart. Once the Dark Wind Spirit Wolf cannot defeat its opponent, it will find an opportunity to escape.
Luo Hao would definitely kill this dark wind spirit wolf in the late stage of becoming a pill, even if Elder He who was chasing him before met him. That powerful aura can tear apart an ordinary Jie Zhen stage monk.
Fortunately, Luo Hao's Chaos All Things Art has turned into all things, and his aura has converged. No matter how powerful the Dark Wind Spirit Wolf is, it cannot sense Luo Hao's aura. The reason why the Dark Wind Spirit Wolf came here is because Luo Hao made a lot of noise by swallowing the Zhen Gathering Pill before. It happened that the Dark Wind Spirit Wolf was not far nearby. When it sensed a lot of spiritual energy fluctuations on Luo Hao's side, it immediately rushed to the cave on Luo Hao's side.
If Luo Hao reacted one step slower, he would be caught by this dark wind spirit wolf. The dark wind spirit wolf explored the area around the cave and didn't notice anything unusual. It howled and then went away in an instant.
When the Dark Wind Spirit Wolf left and Luo Hao felt that the Dark Wind Spirit Wolf could no longer detect this side of the cave, he cautiously reached out with his spiritual sense. When he found that there was nothing abnormal around him, Luo Hao came out of the grass.
Luo Hao has decided to leave He Valley. It is too dangerous here. Even the four forbidden areas in the Hengduan Mountains are not as dangerous as here. Luo Hao changed his appearance for a while, and then cautiously rushed to the exit of He Valley. Fortunately, there were no dangers along the way. An hour later, Luo Hao finally rushed out of He Valley.
